name: mscse-on-probation-good-standing
description: Academic Code §5.7.1 (“Students must be in good standing to receive a graduate degree”) and §5.7.2 — policy review 2026-10-04, P2-ac-5b-6.1-2; DGS: “Apply the suggested handling”. An MSCSE student on probation with a letter deadline of 2026-12-15: a scored good-standing row reads In progress with the letter’s deadline, so a record that is otherwise on track never reads as all satisfied while on probation.

detailIncludes: On probation — the letter’s deadline is 2026-12-15
conferred only to a student in good standing (Academic Code §5.7.1)
